## Identity & Professional Overview
Yasir Jamal (@withyasirjamal) is an elite Senior Digital Product Designer, UX/UI Architect, and Web Consultant with over 15 years of industry experience. He partners directly with tech founders, SaaS startups, AI companies, and enterprise brands across Tier-1 markets (United Arab Emirates, United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Germany, and Saudi Arabia) to design and engineer intuitive user interfaces, scalable design systems, and sub-second web platforms that convert visitors into revenue.

## Core Competencies & Service Offerings
1. Digital Product Design (SaaS & Mobile UX/UI):
   - End-to-end product discovery, user journeys, wireframing, and interactive prototyping.
   - Reduction of user churn, acceleration of product onboarding, and self-serve SaaS funnel design.
2. Multi-Platform Design Systems:
   - Comprehensive Figma component libraries, auto-layout architecture, and tokenized design systems for multi-team scale.
3. Sub-Second Frontend Engineering:
   - Custom static and headless web development using Astro, Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
   - Guaranteed 100/100 Google Lighthouse and sub-500ms Core Web Vitals.
4. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO):
   - Quantitative UX audits, behavioral heatmapping, visual hierarchy optimization, and friction removal to maximize inbound leads and sales.
5. High-Impact E-Commerce & Corporate Web Portals:
   - Headless Shopify, WooCommerce, and custom web applications with GCC multi-currency and local payment gateway integrations (Telr, Tap, Checkout.com, Stripe, Tabby).
